scope: DOCX structural loops and per-item images
features: Nested blocks, including blocks within rows
Per-item image keys with independent relationships
Empty arrays remove loop content; empty table cells keep a paragraph

checks.independentChecker: Drawing IDs are validated for positive integer values and package-wide uniqueness; a mutation test detects duplicates
checks.productionApiSmoke: Passed DOCX/PDF levels 20 and 61, including empty lists, and DOCX level 100 through the HTTP worker

visual.method: Actual and reference DOCX converted separately by the pinned LibreOffice container, rasterized with pdftoppm at 96 DPI, then compared as decoded RGBA pixels
visual.limitations: Selected synthetic fixtures, same converter/fonts only; no claim of repair-free Microsoft Word opening or all-format fidelity

renderTimings.method: One local corpus pass, no controlled benchmark; SDK rather than worker timing

knownLimits: Arrays of scalar items, inline text loops and multi-row selections are not supported
Repeated bookmarks/comments/notes, tracked changes, vertical merges, bound controls and VML/OLE need specialized adapters
LibreOffice stress level 93 can still time out; converter recovery remains enabled
Full OOXML schema validation and real-world document coverage remain future work
next: XLSX typed cells and image attachments, followed by row/formula/range rewriting
